title: Normality of a saturated monoid algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $Q$ be a finitely generated saturated submonoid of a torsion-free abelian group $G$, with group completion $G$. Then $k[Q]$ is integrally closed in $k[G]$: every element of $k[G]$ integral over $k[Q]$ already belongs to $k[Q]$. We use the monoid and group-completion conventions of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.2.9 and the monomial-basis normalization argument, printed p.104

proof.text: Let $x\in k[G]$ be integral over $k[Q]$. By the definition of the group algebra it has a finite support $S=\{g\in G:c_g\ne0\}$ and an expression $x=\sum_{g\in S}c_ge^g$. Apply [lem-trf-integral-support-saturation] with $P=Q$. Its hypotheses hold: $k$ is a field, $Q$ is a finitely generated submonoid of the torsion-free abelian group $G$, and $x$ is integral over $k[Q]$. Therefore every $g\in S$ belongs to $Q^{\mathrm{sat}}=\{h\in G:\exists n>0,\ nh\in Q\}$.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.2.9, printed p.104; agent deduction from the support-in-saturation statement

proof.text: Fix $g\in S$. Step 1 gives an integer $n>0$ with $ng\in Q$. The group-completion hypothesis identifies $G$ with $Q^{\mathrm{gp}}$, so the saturation condition in [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] applies to $g$ and gives $g\in Q$. Hence $S\subseteq Q$.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.2.9, printed p.104; agent deduction from the support-in-saturation statement

proof.text: The monoid algebra $k[Q]$ consists of the finite formal sums $\sum_{q\in Q}a_qe^q$, with multiplication $e^qe^{q\prime}=e^{q+q\prime}$. Its map to $k[G]$ sends each monomial to the monomial with the same exponent and coefficient; it is injective because $Q\subseteq G$. Since $S\subseteq Q$, the finite coefficient function $a_q=c_q$ on $S$ and $a_q=0$ off $S$ is an element of $k[Q]$ whose image is exactly $x$. Thus $x\in k[Q]$. For $S=\varnothing$ the same construction is the zero element. This proves the asserted integral closedness in $k[G]$.
